purpose: Exploratory reconstruction benchmark of added starter features; not original pregame predictions or live model admission

model.objective: mean binary log loss + 0.5 * sum(squared slopes)
model.standardization: training mean and population standard deviation; zero variance maps to zero
model.optimizer: Newton with partial-pivot linear solve and backtracking; gradient max below 1e-10; max 100 iterations; failure refuses

missing_data: Refuse incomplete features or label; use participant-v2 historical exclusions without adding appearances or changing cutoffs

baselines.team_matched: one-feature logistic fitted on exactly the same complete training rows
baselines.team_full: previous frozen team-form model, fitted on all feature-complete training rows

evaluation.paired: identical intersection for all six models; home win orientation
measures: paired Brier and log-loss differences versus every baseline
evaluation.selection: no tuning, refit, or automatic selection; report validation and test even if unfavorable
evaluation.limitations: June outcomes have already been inspected in prior research; exploratory reuse, not an untouched confirmatory holdout. No verified sportsbook baseline or original pregame timing. No ROI claims.
